name: Bichlalm
kurzbeschreibung: The Bichlalm on the sunny ridge of the Kitzb?hel Alps beckons at almost 1,600 m above sea level with mountain views, an alpine Kneipp pool, and gentle tourism.
oeffnungszeiten: Mitte Juni bis Anfang Oktober täglich 09:00–17:00 Uhr
beschreibung:
Overview

The Bichlalm nestles against the sun-drenched southern slope of the Bichlalm ridge in the Kitzb?hel Alps above Kitzb?hel and Aurach. Situated at an altitude of 1,597 metres above sea level, this alpine plateau is considered a peaceful haven away from the hustle and bustle, offering a breathtaking 360-degree panorama: The view extends from the rugged limestone crags of the Wilder Kaiser over the Kitzb?heler Horn and Hohe Salve to the glaciated peaks of the Hohe Tauern. Hikers, tranquility seekers, and nature lovers appreciate this sun-kissed plateau as a paradise for gentle alpine tourism.

History & Special Features

Tourism development began in 1958 when Kitzb?hel tourism pioneer Andr? Bachler constructed the legendary single-seater chairlift up to the Bichlalm. For decades, this nostalgic lift carried generations of summer holidaymakers until it was decommissioned at the end of 2005 due to concession regulations. Following dedicated civic initiatives, the lift company Bergbahn AG KitzSki invested over five million euros and opened a modern, eco-friendly double chairlift by Leitner in 2015. A unique attraction on the alpine pasture is the natural Berg-Kneippanlage at nearly 1,600 metres: Fed directly by ice-cold, crystal-clear mountain spring water, it ranks among the highest Kneipp facilities in Tyrol. At the Berggasthof Bichlalm, traditional Tyrolean alpine specialties prepared with regional ingredients are served.

Visit & Getting There

The chairlift operated by KitzSki is in service during the summer season from mid-June to early October daily from 09:00 to 17:00 (extended autumn weekends during stable weather). Summer rates 2025/2026: Round-trip ticket for adults approx. ? 26.00 to ? 33.00 (discounted with regional guest cards), youths approx. ? 18.00 to ? 19.50, children (born 2011?2019) approx. ? 11.50 to ? 12.50, children under 6 ride free. With the Kitzb?heler Alpen Sommer Card, the cable car ride is free. Very popular is the combined ticket with the Kitzb?heler Hornbahn (approx. ? 33.00), which includes the high-altitude panoramic hike across the karst plateau. Getting there by public transport: By train to Kitzb?hel railway station, from where the KitzSki Bichlalmbus takes hikers directly to the valley station on Bichlalmweg. By car: From Kitzb?hel take the B161 (Pass-Thurn-Stra?e) towards Aurach, turn left onto Bichlalmweg until reaching the free hikers' car park at the valley station.

Tips

The chairlift is designed as an open 2-seater; for passengers with reduced mobility, the attentive staff slows the operating speed during boarding and disembarking, and foldable wheelchairs can be transported. On the alpine plateau, sturdy hiking boots and surefootedness are advised. The approximately one-hour ascent from the mountain station to the summit of the Stuckkogel (1,888 m) is well worth the effort. Be sure to pack a towel to refresh your feet in the invigorating Kneipp basin after your hike.
